children.name:
Own one durable queue and run history for chat replies and work tasks.
      Grant short runner and provider leases, record bounded context and
      results, and retain coding attempts, checkpoints, rewind, and fork.
terms:
"
      Own one durable queue and run history for chat replies and work tasks.
      Grant short runner and provider leases, record bounded context and
      results, and retain coding attempts, checkpoints, rewind, and fork.
      "
"Represent the queued job and its execution as one durable run with one status lifecycle."
"A second job state would disagree with run history during failure or retry."
"Do not start a runtime directly when a run is enqueued."
"Grant a separate expiring permit for every model call, including calls by delegated agents."
"A global provider limit measures simultaneous calls across all runners, not running jobs."
"Do not treat a run lease as a provider permit."
"Let the product choose author, channel, source relation, and at most one final message per attempt."
"A runner may provide a draft but cannot publish as a human or redirect its reply."
"Do not publish partial output as ordinary conversation messages or overwrite permanent summaries."

children.name: Every run has exactly one immutable origin matching its kind: a source message with version and hash, a human manual request, a workflow request, or a ChannelSession with its human principal, session, channel and explicit instruction.

children.name: I02: ChatReply and channel-session WorkTask may omit a workstream. Operations on tickets or workstreams still require their actual identities. Both use the same queue, lease, attempt and result lifecycle.
terms: "I02: ChatReply and channel-session WorkTask may omit a workstream. Operations on tickets or workstreams still require their actual identities. Both use the same queue, lease, attempt and result lifecycle."

children.name: Queueing never requires runner connectivity. Claiming atomically selects one queued run for its owning active runner and retains the queued snapshot version and fingerprint.
terms: "Queueing never requires runner connectivity. Claiming atomically selects one queued run for its owning active runner and retains the queued snapshot version and fingerprint."

children.name: Claiming also respects the owning runner's reported maximum concurrent runs; an inventory update cannot move a queued run to another runner.
terms: "Claiming also respects the owning runner's reported maximum concurrent runs; an inventory update cannot move a queued run to another runner."

children.name: Queueing creates a durable availability signal for the owning runner; control requests create durable control signals. Reading signals requires that runner's current credential and returns only its own signals in strictly increasing sequence order after the supplied cursor.
terms: "Queueing creates a durable availability signal for the owning runner; control requests create durable control signals. Reading signals requires that runner's current credential and returns only its own signals in strictly increasing sequence order after the supplied cursor."

children.name: Recovering a run creates a new availability signal. A live signal connection is closed when its runner key rotates or the runner is revoked; reconnecting requires fresh authentication.
terms: "Recovering a run creates a new availability signal. A live signal connection is closed when its runner key rotates or the runner is revoked; reconnecting requires fresh authentication."

children.name: Live signal delivery is only a wake-up hint; reconnecting runners read durable signals by cursor and still claim runs or acknowledge controls through their separate operations.
terms: "Live signal delivery is only a wake-up hint; reconnecting runners read durable signals by cursor and still claim runs or acknowledge controls through their separate operations."

children.name: Queue authorization verifies current inventory, participation, product policy, immutable origin, and effective capabilities before the run is stored.
terms: "Queue authorization verifies current inventory, participation, product policy, immutable origin, and effective capabilities before the run is stored."

children.name: At most one unexpired lease exists per attempt. Claim, renewal, progress, and completion are idempotent; reports from expired or superseded leases cannot change state.
terms: "At most one unexpired lease exists per attempt. Claim, renewal, progress, and completion are idempotent; reports from expired or superseded leases cannot change state."

children.name: The first TurnStarted activity starts the leased attempt and records input provenance and history boundary. Waiting marks the run Waiting; Resumed resumes it as Running, preserving its start time.
terms: "The first TurnStarted activity starts the leased attempt and records input provenance and history boundary. Waiting marks the run Waiting; Resumed resumes it as Running, preserving its start time."

children.name: local reclaim rejects an unauthenticated runner
local replacement verifies confirmed parent history
local replacement rejects missing parent history

Only the current queued Interactive ChannelSession replacement attempt may be reclaimed. Its direct parent is a stopped recovery or acknowledged control attempt; human, channel, runner, agent and pinned snapshot stay bound to the original delegation. Reclaim assigns its own new runtime, preserves immutable run origin and purpose, atomically acquires capacity and rechecks current authority.
terms: "Only the current queued Interactive ChannelSession replacement attempt may be reclaimed. Its direct parent is a stopped recovery or acknowledged control attempt; human, channel, runner, agent and pinned snapshot stay bound to the original delegation. Reclaim assigns its own new runtime, preserves immutable run origin and purpose, atomically acquires capacity and rechecks current authority."

children.name: local reclaim binds one queued replacement to confirmed parent history
terms: "local reclaim binds one queued replacement to confirmed parent history"

children.name: local reclaim rejects reusing the parent runtime
terms: "local reclaim rejects reusing the parent runtime"

children.name: Local reclaim requires a complete canonical confirmed history snapshot of the direct parent, available referenced workspace data and sufficient current capabilities. Rewind or fork requires the selected checkpoint's history snapshot. A requested native checkpoint must be documented compatible. Unconfirmed parent writing tools block reclaim.
terms: "Local reclaim requires a complete canonical confirmed history snapshot of the direct parent, available referenced workspace data and sufficient current capabilities. Rewind or fork requires the selected checkpoint's history snapshot. A requested native checkpoint must be documented compatible. Unconfirmed parent writing tools block reclaim."

children.name: Identical local reclaim lease, runtime and continuation retries preserve assignment identity. Changed or superseded retries fail; previous attempts, progress, summaries and sealed history remain intact. Autonomous claim cannot replace delegated reclaim.
terms: "Identical local reclaim lease, runtime and continuation retries preserve assignment identity. Changed or superseded retries fail; previous attempts, progress, summaries and sealed history remain intact. Autonomous claim cannot replace delegated reclaim."

children.name: A runner key is checked for every claim, lease renewal, context request, permit, progress, checkpoint, result, and control acknowledgement.
terms: "A runner key is checked for every claim, lease renewal, context request, permit, progress, checkpoint, result, and control acknowledgement."

children.name: Runner authorization validates the presented secret in trusted request context against the current verifier; caller-supplied runner ID and key ID are never sufficient.
terms: "Runner authorization validates the presented secret in trusted request context against the current verifier; caller-supplied runner ID and key ID are never sufficient."

children.name: No provider call, including delegated calls, starts without an unexpired permit for that call ID and a configured global provider limit; permits count calls, not runs.
terms: "No provider call, including delegated calls, starts without an unexpired permit for that call ID and a configured global provider limit; permits count calls, not runs."

children.name: Permit acquisition is atomic across runners, never exceeds the global provider limit, and also respects the runner's reported local capacity. Release or expiry frees capacity.
terms: "Permit acquisition is atomic across runners, never exceeds the global provider limit, and also respects the runner's reported local capacity. Release or expiry frees capacity."

children.name: Connection loss cannot authorize a model call. A runner without a valid permit must wait even while its run lease remains valid.
terms: "Connection loss cannot authorize a model call. A runner without a valid permit must wait even while its run lease remains valid."

children.name: Chat context is authorized for the pinned participation, ends at the source message, obeys the token boundary, and records ordered IDs, versions, hashes, and omissions without storing message content again.
terms: "Chat context is authorized for the pinned participation, ends at the source message, obeys the token boundary, and records ordered IDs, versions, hashes, and omissions without storing message content again."

children.name: The recorded context manifest exactly matches the content delivered for that attempt in order; a retry returns the same bounded selection or records a new versioned selection before use.
terms: "The recorded context manifest exactly matches the content delivered for that attempt in order; a retry returns the same bounded selection or records a new versioned selection before use."

children.name: Only the product chooses the agent author, target channel, and source relation from immutable run data. A runner submits drafts, typed activity and work summaries but cannot select a different public author or target.
terms: "Only the product chooses the agent author, target channel, and source relation from immutable run data. A runner submits drafts, typed activity and work summaries but cannot select a different public author or target."

children.name: For ChatReply at most one final public reply exists per attempt. Every attempt has one mutating progress identity; multiple interactive turns may each publish a distinct immutable summary. Duplicate publications return the same message ID without another event.
terms: "For ChatReply at most one final public reply exists per attempt. Every attempt has one mutating progress identity; multiple interactive turns may each publish a distinct immutable summary. Duplicate publications return the same message ID without another event."

children.name: Result preparation atomically verifies the current lease and derives author, channel, and source relation before publication; retries reuse the same preparation.
terms: "Result preparation atomically verifies the current lease and derives author, channel, and source relation before publication; retries reuse the same preparation."

children.name: For a chat origin, result preparation copies the immutable source message ID, version, hash, and participation into the publication check. ChannelWork summaries derive their target from the channel context and require no invented chat source; WorkTasks publish their final saved summary on autonomous completion.
terms: "For a chat origin, result preparation copies the immutable source message ID, version, hash, and participation into the publication check. ChannelWork summaries derive their target from the channel context and require no invented chat source; WorkTasks publish their final saved summary on autonomous completion."

children.name: If the source message was edited or deleted, or required membership was revoked, the public reply is suppressed with a recorded reason.
terms: "If the source message was edited or deleted, or required membership was revoked, the public reply is suppressed with a recorded reason."

children.name: A writing tool started without confirmed completion blocks automatic resume after lease loss until reconciled; no retry may silently repeat its side effect.
terms: "A writing tool started without confirmed completion blocks automatic resume after lease loss until reconciled; no retry may silently repeat its side effect."

children.name: Recovery abandons the expired attempt and queues a new attempt pinned to the original snapshot and origin; an unconfirmed writing tool yields UnconfirmedToolWrite until an authorized human records a supported reconciliation.
terms: "Recovery abandons the expired attempt and queues a new attempt pinned to the original snapshot and origin; an unconfirmed writing tool yields UnconfirmedToolWrite until an authorized human records a supported reconciliation."

children.name: A writing-tool reconciliation names one existing unconfirmed event and a verified outcome; it is append-only and cannot erase the original event or authorize a silent duplicate side effect.
terms: "A writing-tool reconciliation names one existing unconfirmed event and a verified outcome; it is append-only and cannot erase the original event or authorize a silent duplicate side effect."

children.name: Cancellation, rewind, and fork are durable product decisions requiring acknowledgement by the owning runner. Prior attempts, messages, and artifacts remain immutable.
terms: "Cancellation, rewind, and fork are durable product decisions requiring acknowledgement by the owning runner. Prior attempts, messages, and artifacts remain immutable."

children.name: Historical snapshots, origin, context manifests, attempts, checkpoints, permits, results, and control decisions remain inspectable under product access rules.
terms: "Historical snapshots, origin, context manifests, attempts, checkpoints, permits, results, and control decisions remain inspectable under product access rules."

children.name: I03-I07: Channel selection, sessions, announcements, turns, summaries and run completion never reserve the channel or automatically mutate ticket readiness or workstream stage. Many runs and humans may work in parallel. The run origin and instruction remain immutable.
terms: "I03-I07: Channel selection, sessions, announcements, turns, summaries and run completion never reserve the channel or automatically mutate ticket readiness or workstream stage. Many runs and humans may work in parallel. The run origin and instruction remain immutable."

children.name: I08-I10: Every attempt pins its actual agent, agent principal, installation, local agent, immutable snapshot, execution mode, human/delegation and continuation provenance. Names and fingerprints never merge installation identities; later inventory changes never rewrite attempts.
terms: "I08-I10: Every attempt pins its actual agent, agent principal, installation, local agent, immutable snapshot, execution mode, human/delegation and continuation provenance. Names and fingerprints never merge installation identities; later inventory changes never rewrite attempts."

children.name: I12-I22: Every mutating runner action validates the current runner key and current execution authority. Channel-session runs additionally require the matching delegation and current human session/account/channel access. Server clock alone checks deadlines. A lease binds one attempt and never reserves its channel; capacity is enforced atomically.
terms: "I12-I22: Every mutating runner action validates the current runner key and current execution authority. Channel-session runs additionally require the matching delegation and current human session/account/channel access. Server clock alone checks deadlines. A lease binds one attempt and never reserves its channel; capacity is enforced atomically."

children.name: I23-I26: Accept batches of at most 100 structured activities in contiguous monotone sequence. Same event ID/sequence/content is idempotent, conflicting reuse fails RunActivityConflict; gaps are explicitly rejected without acknowledging missing data. Persist activity plus projection job atomically, repair pending projections after restart and publish realtime only after commit. One stable progress identity per attempt has monotone revisions, stable createdAt/position and persistent deletion tombstone.
terms: "I23-I26: Accept batches of at most 100 structured activities in contiguous monotone sequence. Same event ID/sequence/content is idempotent, conflicting reuse fails RunActivityConflict; gaps are explicitly rejected without acknowledging missing data. Persist activity plus projection job atomically, repair pending projections after restart and publish realtime only after commit. One stable progress identity per attempt has monotone revisions, stable createdAt/position and persistent deletion tombstone."

children.name: I27-I28: Assistant and tool starts use stable IDs; completions must name an existing start in the same attempt/turn, nested tools name a known parent. Progress updates create no implicit agent triggers, mention fanouts or unread increase per update. A summary never reconciles an unconfirmed writing tool.
terms: "I27-I28: Assistant and tool starts use stable IDs; completions must name an existing start in the same attempt/turn, nested tools name a known parent. Progress updates create no implicit agent triggers, mention fanouts or unread increase per update. A summary never reconciles an unconfirmed writing tool."

children.name: RunTurnHistoryVerifier is an InspectableRuns-owned injected contract implemented by RunHistory. It recomputes and validates sealed snapshot integrity from the persisted ordered sections and content, checks contiguous confirmed coverage and actual byte hashes, and returns a server-issued proof. Proofs are never accepted as HTTP input. Missing, incomplete, mismatched run/attempt/turn/cursor, or corrupted history fails RunHistoryRequired before turn or pause writes.
terms: "RunTurnHistoryVerifier is an InspectableRuns-owned injected contract implemented by RunHistory. It recomputes and validates sealed snapshot integrity from the persisted ordered sections and content, checks contiguous confirmed coverage and actual byte hashes, and returns a server-issued proof. Proofs are never accepted as HTTP input. Missing, incomplete, mismatched run/attempt/turn/cursor, or corrupted history fails RunHistoryRequired before turn or pause writes."

children.name: History verification and the matching turn or pause repository operation share one transaction context, with no nested document-store transaction. Current authorization, confirmed cursor and proof matching are rechecked at commit so a concurrent upload cannot make a pause proof stale; failure commits no partial changes.
terms: "History verification and the matching turn or pause repository operation share one transaction context, with no nested document-store transaction. Current authorization, confirmed cursor and proof matching are rechecked at commit so a concurrent upload cannot make a pause proof stale; failure commits no partial changes."

children.name: AgentRunApi.completeTurn and pause authenticate the runner, invoke the history verifier once before the repository, and forward the exact verified proof. The repository validates that proof against its current run/channel/attempt and lease/delegation; pause additionally requires the completed latest turn and no newer confirmed history or unreconciled writes. Neither slice imports another owner's concrete repository.
terms: "AgentRunApi.completeTurn and pause authenticate the runner, invoke the history verifier once before the repository, and forward the exact verified proof. The repository validates that proof against its current run/channel/attempt and lease/delegation; pause additionally requires the completed latest turn and no newer confirmed history or unreconciled writes. Neither slice imports another owner's concrete repository."

children.name: Activity pages derive the current active human principal from an opaque session credential and enforce current channel access before return. A beforeSequence or afterSequence of zero means no boundary; nonzero boundaries are exclusive, only one direction is accepted, and the result contains at most limit stored events from the requested attempt in ascending sequence. Before pages choose the nearest preceding events, after pages choose the earliest following events. Next cursors exist only when more data exists in their direction. Inspection does not embed the unbounded event history.
terms: "Activity pages derive the current active human principal from an opaque session credential and enforce current channel access before return. A beforeSequence or afterSequence of zero means no boundary; nonzero boundaries are exclusive, only one direction is accepted, and the result contains at most limit stored events from the requested attempt in ascending sequence. Before pages choose the nearest preceding events, after pages choose the earliest following events. Next cursors exist only when more data exists in their direction. Inspection does not embed the unbounded event history."

children.name: I29-I34: TurnStarted creates a RunTurn with its inputs and confirmed history boundary. completeTurn requires a nonempty successful WorkTask summary, or an explicit failure/abort report, and a sealed confirmed history snapshot for that same run/attempt/turn. It saves the summary and turn atomically without completing an interactive run. publishSummary is separate and idempotent. complete explicitly ends only this run, releasing every lease and provider permit; autonomous WorkTask completion publishes its final summary. ChatReply alone may use NoAnswer.
terms: "I29-I34: TurnStarted creates a RunTurn with its inputs and confirmed history boundary. completeTurn requires a nonempty successful WorkTask summary, or an explicit failure/abort report, and a sealed confirmed history snapshot for that same run/attempt/turn. It saves the summary and turn atomically without completing an interactive run. publishSummary is separate and idempotent. complete explicitly ends only this run, releasing every lease and provider permit; autonomous WorkTask completion publishes its final summary. ChatReply alone may use NoAnswer."

children.name: I35-I42: Continuations import only confirmed portable history and available workspace artifacts, never rerun imported tools or inherit authority. They create a new run/attempt/runtime session with explicit source links. Recovery of one lost execution creates a new attempt. Safe pause between turns requires sealed confirmed history and no unreconciled writing tools; pause releases leases and permits. Resume rechecks authorization, snapshot capabilities and capacities.
terms: "I35-I42: Continuations import only confirmed portable history and available workspace artifacts, never rerun imported tools or inherit authority. They create a new run/attempt/runtime session with explicit source links. Recovery of one lost execution creates a new attempt. Safe pause between turns requires sealed confirmed history and no unreconciled writing tools; pause releases leases and permits. Resume rechecks authorization, snapshot capabilities and capacities."

children.name: I18-I22: Provider permits default to 60 seconds and run leases to five minutes. Renew requires the same live call, attempt, lease, runner key and execution authority and must not reactivate expired, released or terminal permits. Every model call including delegation has its own permit; absence of a global configured limit grants no capacity.
terms: "I18-I22: Provider permits default to 60 seconds and run leases to five minutes. Renew requires the same live call, attempt, lease, runner key and execution authority and must not reactivate expired, released or terminal permits. Every model call including delegation has its own permit; absence of a global configured limit grants no capacity."

children.name: I11/I45: Inspection and history use current channel authorization even for the original requester or administrator. Scoped realtime events carry the channel ID and never include full portable history; access loss disconnects streams.
terms: "I11/I45: Inspection and history use current channel authorization even for the original requester or administrator. Scoped realtime events carry the channel ID and never include full portable history; access loss disconnects streams."

children.name: I48-I50: Business failure after any write rolls back the whole transaction, including projection/publication jobs. Retries after lost acknowledgements produce no duplicate messages, events, triggers or notifications. Used context versions, including ticket revision and artifact hashes, are retained; connectivity grants no rights.
terms: "I48-I50: Business failure after any write rolls back the whole transaction, including projection/publication jobs. Retries after lost acknowledgements produce no duplicate messages, events, triggers or notifications. Used context versions, including ticket revision and artifact hashes, are retained; connectivity grants no rights."

children.name: Connectivity is informational only; never grants authorization: it reports the last successful runner authentication or signal poll.
terms: "Connectivity is informational only; never grants authorization: it reports the last successful runner authentication or signal poll."
